storefront_help_faq_shipping_cost_a: Standard shipping is free on orders over Rp500,000. Below that, a flat rate is calculated at checkout based on your destination.
storefront_help_faq_delivery_time_a: Standard orders arrive in 3–5 business days. Express delivery is available at checkout for 1–2 business day arrival.
storefront_help_faq_tracking_a: Yes. Once your order ships you will receive a tracking link by email, and you can follow its progress anytime on the order tracking page.
storefront_help_faq_returns_a: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a refund. Items must be unused and in their original packaging.
storefront_help_faq_refunds_a: Refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–7 business days after we receive and inspect your return.
storefront_help_faq_support_a: We reply to most requests within one business day, Monday through Friday. Express delivery orders and damaged items are prioritised.
storefront_help_faq_secure_a: Yes. Payments are processed over an encrypted connection by PCI-compliant providers, and we never store your full card details.

storefront_pp_benefit_secure_desc: Card details and payment tokens are encrypted end to end, with automated fraud monitoring on every checkout.
storefront_pp_benefit_delivery_desc: If an eligible order never arrives, we refund the full amount or send a replacement at no extra cost.
storefront_pp_benefit_described_desc: Covered when the item you receive differs materially from the listing description, photos, or specifications.
storefront_pp_benefit_damage_desc: Report damage within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the packaging and the item so we can make it right.
storefront_pp_benefit_returns_desc: Unused items in their original condition can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a refund or credit.
storefront_pp_benefit_support_desc: Real people review every claim and work with you until the case reaches a fair resolution.

storefront_privacy_intro: How {store} collects, uses and protects your personal information.
storefront_privacy_collect_intro: We collect information you provide directly, information generated when you shop with us, and limited technical data from the devices you use. The exact data depends on how you interact with {store}.
storefront_privacy_collect_account_text: Your name, email address, phone number, saved addresses and login credentials.
storefront_privacy_collect_order_text: Products purchased, delivery and billing addresses, order history, returns and refund records.
storefront_privacy_collect_payment_text: Card brand, last four digits, expiry and billing address. Full card numbers are handled by our payment processors and are never stored on our servers.
storefront_privacy_collect_device_text: IP address, browser type, operating system, referring pages, and the pages and products you view.
storefront_privacy_collect_comms_text: Messages you send to support, product reviews, survey responses and marketing preferences.
storefront_privacy_use_intro: We use personal information to operate {store} and to make your shopping experience reliable, secure and relevant. Specifically, we use it to:
storefront_privacy_use_fulfil_text: Process payments, arrange delivery, handle returns and provide order updates.
storefront_privacy_use_support_text: Respond to questions, resolve disputes and troubleshoot account issues.
storefront_privacy_use_fraud_text: Detect suspicious activity, verify transactions and protect customers and {store}.
storefront_privacy_use_personalize_text: Recommend products, remember preferences and tailor offers, subject to your choices.
storefront_privacy_use_legal_text: Comply with tax, accounting, consumer protection and other applicable laws.
storefront_privacy_sharing_intro: We share personal information only with service providers that help us run the store, and only to the extent needed for their work. We do not sell your personal information.
storefront_privacy_sharing_carriers_text: that deliver orders and provide tracking updates.
storefront_privacy_sharing_hosting_text: that keep the site available and help us understand how it is used.
storefront_privacy_sharing_legal_text: where we are required to disclose information or must protect our rights and users.
storefront_privacy_never_sell_lead: We never sell your personal data.
storefront_privacy_never_sell_text: We may share aggregated, de-identified insights, but never information that identifies you.
storefront_privacy_cookies_intro: Cookies and similar technologies help us keep you signed in, remember your cart and understand how the store performs. We use three broad categories:
storefront_privacy_cookies_essential_tex: needed for checkout, security and core site functions. These cannot be switched off.
storefront_privacy_cookies_analytics_tex: that show us which pages are visited and how customers move through the store, so we can improve it.
storefront_privacy_cookies_preference_te: that remember choices such as currency, language and recently viewed items.
storefront_privacy_cookies_manage: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent checkout and account features from working correctly.
storefront_privacy_security_1: We protect personal information with encryption in transit, access controls and monitoring designed to prevent unauthorized access, loss or misuse.
storefront_privacy_security_2: Only team members and service providers who need information to perform their work can access it, and we review permissions regularly. We retain personal data only for as long as needed to provide our services, meet legal obligations, resolve disputes and enforce agreements.
storefront_privacy_security_3: No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. If you believe your account has been compromised, contact us right away.
storefront_privacy_rights_intro: Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete or port your personal information, and to object to or restrict certain processing.
storefront_privacy_rights_access_text: a copy of the personal information we hold about you.
storefront_privacy_rights_deletion_text: of information we no longer need for a lawful purpose.
storefront_privacy_rights_portability_te: of data you provided, in a structured, commonly used format.
storefront_privacy_rights_objection_text: to processing based on legitimate interests, including some marketing.
storefront_privacy_rights_exercise: To exercise a right, email us at
storefront_privacy_rights_verify: We may ask you to verify your identity, and we will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.
storefront_privacy_children_1: {store} is not intended for children under 13, or under 16 in regions where a higher age applies. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children below these ages.
storefront_privacy_children_2: If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, please contact us and we will take steps to delete it.
storefront_privacy_changes_1: We may update this policy to reflect changes in our practices, technology or legal requirements. When we do, we will post the revised version on this page and update the "Last updated" date above.
storefront_privacy_changes_2: If a change materially affects how we use your personal information, we will provide a clearer notice, such as an email or a banner on the site, before it takes effect.
storefront_privacy_contact_intro: If you have questions about this policy or how your information is handled, our team is happy to help.

storefront_shipping_faq_processing_q: How long does order processing take?
storefront_shipping_faq_processing_a: Orders are picked and packed within 1–2 business days after payment clears. Orders placed before 2 PM local time usually ship the same day, while orders placed on weekends or public holidays ship on the next business day.
storefront_shipping_faq_free_a: Standard shipping is free on orders that meet our free-shipping threshold shown at checkout. The discount is applied automatically to your order summary before you pay, so no promo code is needed.
storefront_shipping_faq_express_q: Can I upgrade to express delivery?
storefront_shipping_faq_express_a: Yes. Express options appear at checkout whenever they are available for your address. Express orders are prioritised and typically arrive in 1–2 business days, with the exact estimate and price shown before you confirm payment.
storefront_shipping_faq_international_a: We ship to most countries worldwide. International delivery times vary by destination and customs clearance. Import duties, taxes and brokerage fees are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included in the shipping cost at checkout.
storefront_shipping_faq_delayed_q: My package is late. What should I do?
storefront_shipping_faq_delayed_a: If tracking has not updated for 48 hours, or your order is past its estimated delivery window, contact our support team with your order number. We will open a carrier investigation and keep you updated until the parcel is found or a replacement is issued.
storefront_shipping_faq_address_q: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
storefront_shipping_faq_address_a: Address changes are possible before the order is packed. Contact support as soon as possible with your order number and the corrected address. Once a parcel is in transit, the carrier may allow a redirect for an additional fee.
storefront_shipping_faq_tracking_q: How do I track my order?
storefront_shipping_faq_tracking_a: A tracking link is emailed as soon as your parcel is handed to the carrier. You can also open Order Tracking in your account to see live status updates, the carrier name and the expected delivery date.
storefront_shipping_faq_damaged_q: What if my package arrives damaged?
storefront_shipping_faq_damaged_a: Please photograph the packaging and the damaged item, then contact support within 7 days of delivery. We will arrange a replacement or refund once the carrier claim is reviewed, and we may ask you to keep the original packaging for inspection.
